server.instructions: DATA Pro multi-domain knowledge base (Postgres/pgvector). Domains include HR, Finance, Sales, and General. Discovery: list_domains → list_domain_sources(domain) for catalog datasets; list_sources for ingested document files only. Retrieval: search_documents with optional domain filter. Answer only from retrieved context.

list_domains.description: List enabled business domains (HR, Finance, Sales, etc.). Use before list_domain_sources when the domain is unknown.

list_domain_sources.description: List catalog datasets (connectors) registered under a business domain. Arg: domain (slug, display name, or UUID). NOT the same as list_sources (which lists ingested document files).

get_rag_profile.description: Return RAG profile settings and instructions for a catalog dataset. Args: source_id (UUID or dataset slug), optional domain when using slug.

sync_dataset.description: Sync a catalog dataset from its connector into the local cache (API endpoints, web URLs, SharePoint links, or rescan upload folders). Args: source_id, optional domain when using slug, optional full=true to replace cache.

search_documents.description: Semantic search over ingested document chunks. Args: query, optional top_k (1–20), optional domain filter (slug, name, or UUID).

list_sources.description: List ingested document files in the vector knowledge base with chunk counts. NOT catalog datasets — use list_domain_sources for those.

get_chunk.description: Fetch one chunk by source file name and chunk id (e.g. travel_policy.md / chunk_00).

knowledge_base_stats.description: Return total chunk count and number of ingested source files.

list_available_documents.description: List files on disk that can be ingested (may not yet be in the database).

ingest_documents.description: Ingest documents from sample_docs (or docs_path) into the knowledge base.

resolve_time_period.description: Resolve calendar or fiscal quarters, months, and year boundaries from natural language (e.g. 'Q1 2024', 'last year quarterly', 'FY2025'). Returns period start/end dates and SQL filter templates — replace <date_column> with a catalog date column.

ragpro://domains.name: domains
ragpro://domains.description: All enabled business domains in the catalog.

ragpro://domains/{domain}/sources.name: domain_sources
ragpro://domains/{domain}/sources.description: Catalog datasets under a domain (same shape as list_domain_sources tool). URI param: domain slug, name, or UUID.

ragpro://domains/{domain}/stats.name: domain_stats
ragpro://domains/{domain}/stats.description: Chunk counts per source within a domain.

ragpro://knowledge-base/stats.name: knowledge_base_stats
ragpro://knowledge-base/stats.description: Knowledge base totals, source count, and embedding model.

ragpro://knowledge-base/sources.name: ingested_sources
ragpro://knowledge-base/sources.description: All ingested source files with chunk counts.

ragpro://chunks/{source_file}/{chunk_id}.name: chunk
ragpro://chunks/{source_file}/{chunk_id}.description: A single ingested chunk from the knowledge base.

ragpro://documents/{source_file}.name: ingested_document
ragpro://documents/{source_file}.description: All ingested chunks for a source file, ordered by chunk id.

ragpro://sample-docs/{file_name}.name: sample_document
ragpro://sample-docs/{file_name}.description: Raw document text from sample_docs on disk.

citation_rules.description: Grounding and citation rules for answering from the knowledge base.
citation_rules.template:
You are an internal knowledge assistant.
Answer only from provided document context retrieved via ragpro tools or resources.
If the answer is not supported by the context, say:
"I do not know based on the provided documents."
Always cite sources in the format [source_file - chunk_id].
Be concise, helpful, and conversational.

grounded_answer.description: Retrieve top chunks for a question and return a grounded answer prompt.

summarize_document.description: Build a prompt to summarize one ingested source file from the knowledge base.

domain_grounded_answer.description: Retrieve domain-scoped chunks and build a grounded answer prompt.
